definitions.short: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse )
definitions.usage: break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, scatter (abroad), spread abroad.
definitions.full: H6327. puwts I. [ מּוּץ ] verb be dispersed, scattered (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; perhaps akin to Arabic break asunder, scatter ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural יָפוּצוּ Psa 68:2 , יָפֻצוּ Ezek 48:16 +; 3 feminine plural וַתְּפוּצֶינָה 34:5 +, וּתְפוּצֶינָה Zech 13:7 , etc.; Imperative masculine plural מֻּצוּ 1Sam 14:34 ; Participle passive plural suffix מּוּצַי Zeph 3:10 (see below); — be dispersed, disperse , בָּעָם 1Sam 14:34 ; be scattered , of enemies 11:11 ; Num 10:35 ; Psa 68:2 ; of Israel (among nations) under figure of flock Ezek 34:5 (twice in verse); Zech 13:7 ; בַּתמּֿוּצַי Zeph 3:10 is probably corrupt, and 3:9 ; 3:10 gloss see Schw ZAW x (1890), 203 Now Da; of besieging army 2Sam 20:22 ( הָעִיר מֵעַל ); people from ( מִן ) possessions Ezek 46:18 ; men (from Babel) Gen 11:4 ( עַל location). Niph`al Perfect 3feminine singular נָפ֫וֺצָה Jer 10:21 , 3 plural נָפֹ֫צוּ Gen 10:18 +, 2 masculine plural נְפֹצֹתֶם Ezek 11:17 +, etc.; Participle feminine נָפ֫וֺצֶת 2Sam 18:8 Qr (> Kt נפצות ) compare Dr and others; plural נְפֹצִים 1Kin 22:17 , נְפוֺצִים 2Chr 18:16 ; — 1 be scattered , of army 2Kin 25:5 ( מֵעַל person) = Jer 52:8 ; 1Kin 22:17 ( אֶל location) = 2Chr 18:16 ( עַל ), compare Jer 40:15 (absolute); of dispersed Israel with ב location Ezek 11:17 ; 20:34 , 41 ; 28:25 , as flock Jer 10:21 ; Ezek 34:6 ( עַל location), 34:12 ( שָׁם ); Egyptians 29:13 ( שָׁמָּה ); of battle scattered over country by defeat 2Sam 18:8 . 2 be spread abroad , of peoples Gen 10:18 . Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular consecutive וְהֵפִיץ Deut 4:27 +, 1 singular consecutive וַהֲפִיצוֺתִי Ezek 22:15 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יָפִיץ Job 37:11 , וַיָּ֫פֶץ Gen 11:8 +, etc.; Imperative masculine singular הָפֵץ Job 40:11 ; Infinitive construct לְהָפִיץ Ezek 20:23 , etc.; — 1 transitive scatter: a. with accusative of person Gen 11:8-9 , ( עַל location), Isa 41:16 ; Hab 3:14 ; with ב Gen 49:7 ; Israel among ( ב ) nations Deut 4:27 ; 28:64 ; Jer 9:15 ; Ezek 11:16 ; 12:15 ; 20:23 ; 22:15 ; 36:19 ; Neh 1:8 ; with שׁמ(הׅ Deut 30:3 ; Jer 30:11 ; with אֶל location Ezek 34:21 ; absolute Jer 13:24 ; 18:17 , under figure of flock 23:1-2 , Gr. reads אֲפִיצֵם also Deut 32:26 (see [ פאה ]); Egyptians (c. ב ) Ezek 29:12 ; 30:23 , 26 ; inhabitants of earth Isa 24:1 . b. with accusative of thing, arrows (figurative for lightnings) 2Sam 22:15 = Psa 18:15 ; 144:6 ; cloud Job 37:11 ; אַמֶּ֑ךָ עַבְרוֺת הָפֵץ 40:11 (i.e. lightnings ?); seed Isa 28:25 . c. וֶהֱפִיצֻהוּ Job 18:11 and drive him (si vera lectio, see conjecture in Bu). 2 intransitive, scatter , with ב location Exod 5:12 , with מֵעַל person 1Sam 13:8 ; of wind Job 38:24 ( עַל location). II. מּוּץ verb flow, overflow (Arabic flow , compare Ba ES 69 ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural יָפוּצוּ Prov 5:16 of springs, figurative for sources of pleasure; 3 feminine plural מִטוֺב עָרַי תְּפוּצֶנָה Zech 1:17 my cities shall overflow with good. [ מָּצַץ ] verb break (Arabic break, break asunder ; Nabataean פצץ break asunder ; Syriac crush ); — Po`. Imperfect 3masculine singular סָ֑לַע יְפֹצֵץ Jer 23:29 a hammer which shatters rock. Hithpo`el Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיִּתְמִּצְצוּ Hab 3:6 and the eternal mountains were shattered (elsewhere √ מּוּץ were scattered ). Pilpel Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix וַיְפַצְמְּצֵנִי Job 16:12 he [God] dashed me in pieces (figurative).
